title: Kamishiro Rui — Piqued Curiosity〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shunmeiza - Studio

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Staff A
rows.Line: Alright, we'll start taking the set down!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Staff B
rows.Line: Okay, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Phew... Things are finally starting to settle down.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It sounded like the others are going to need a little more time to get changed, so I might take a quick break here.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Still, Tsukasa's performance this time around was nothing like his other ones...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That must've been...)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Nice work today, Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mr. Kato, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This ended up being a wonderful experience for all of us. We really appreciate you allowing us to be a part of your show.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I'm glad to hear that. I can't help but smile whenever I get to do a show with young people who are so passionate about theatre.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I have a feeling that putting on a show with you and your friends opened this troupe's eyes to a variety of things.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: In other words, inviting Wonderlands×Showtime over to perform with Shunmeiza was an excellent decision.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: And I got to witness something rather nice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nice?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm talking about Tenma.
He's a little rough around the edges, but he has that spark.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Catching a glimpse of his growth on the stage was quite something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes...
I'm always surprised at how quickly he continues to grow.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although, he had some trouble with his role for this show...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I know. I did give him a fairly difficult task. However...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: He was able to figure out what he needed to do much faster than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Which allowed him to “become” his character.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I felt the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In that instant... He'd truly disappeared into Nakayama.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: He reminded me how actors really are an interesting breed.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: And... I have a feeling that the sky's the limit for him.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I'm of the same opinion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Tsukasa just keeps finding ways to get better and better...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which means I need to do the same as his director.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Ah, while we're on the subject, I heard that you've directed just about all of your troupe's shows. Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Yes, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Interesting. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I told Tenma that I took the time to watch several of your troupe's shows. As such, have had the chance to observe your work as the director.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: And I have to say, Kamishiro, you seem to come up with the most stunning effects.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: It's obvious that you want everybody in the audience to experience something new, smile and have fun. That much is clear from your work.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Not only that, the actors you work with all seem to have a spring in their step.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: That to me is proof that you know how to allow them to shine their brightest on stage. You have that sixth sense, so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...
I'm honored by your words.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: And I'm curious to see how you grow as a director moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I hope you get to learn and experience many more new things in the future as you hone your craft.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. Me too.
se_walk_men_002_2

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I never expected to hear such praise from Shunmeiza's director.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'm surprised...but also incredibly happy. I mean, he just validated my ideas.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He saw that I want everybody in the audience to experience something new, smile and have fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's wonderful to hear from someone like him that he understands what I'm trying to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Not only that, the actors you work with all seem to have a spring in their step.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: That to me is proof that you know how to allow them to shine their brightest on stage. You have that sixth sense, so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If my directing skills can help everyone shine on stage...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then I'll keep doing everything I can to make them radiant.
